dimensions.assessment: Affects state educational entities, charter school operators, and students attending charter schools.
dimensions.evidence: paying for the Federal share of the cost of acquiring and maintaining charter school facilities

dimensions.assessment: Modifies federal grant award criteria, sets a 60 percent federal share limit, and permits revolving loan funds and building code assistance.
dimensions.evidence: The Federal share of the cost of carrying out the activities described in subparagraph (E) shall be not more than an amount equal to 60 percent

dimensions.assessment: Restructures existing Charter Schools Program grant allocations and cost-sharing without specifying new total appropriations.
dimensions.evidence: Funds made available under this subsection shall be used to supplement, and not supplant, non-Federal funds

dimensions.assessment: Amends multiple sections of the Elementary and Secondary Education Act of 1965 regarding charter school facilities and federal interest rules.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary shall award, on a competitive basis, grants to State entities that have the highest-quality applications

dimensions.assessment: Establishes multi-year grant periods (up to 5 years) and ongoing reporting rules for grant recipients.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary shall award grants under this subsection for periods of not more than 5 years

Number of charter schools or states expected to receive grants
importance_detail.rationale: The bill replaces the State Charter School Facilities Incentive Grant program with a new competitive grant structure, alters use of funds under existing state entity programs, and adjusts reporting rules.
